verdict.rationale: Trello documents a public REST API with an introduction guide covering API key generation, delegated auth via the 1/authorize route or OAuth1.0, and configurable token scope and expiry. Its REST reference lists resources including Batch, Search and Webhooks, which is enough to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes found none at common paths), detailed evidence of endpoint coverage beyond section names, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
